author: HBO Max
description:
Welcome to Lanterns: The Official Podcast where Host Juju Green previews the new DC Studios series, starring Kyle Chandler as Hal Jordan and Aaron Pierre as John Stewart.  

Through interviews with the creators, cast and crew, the podcast goes inside the making of Lanterns, from the murder mystery at the heart of the story to the characters, comic lore, and dive into the worldbuilding, and the relationship between Hal Jordan and John Stewart.  

Whether you're a longtime Green Lantern fan or new to the Corps, Lanterns: The Official Podcast is your companion to the series, with Juju breaking down the episodes and talking directly with the people who brought them to life. 

🔔 Subscribe to DC and HBO Max so you never miss an episode of Lanterns: The Official Podcast. Stream Lanterns on HBO Max and watch full episodes of the podcast on HBO Max, the HBO Max and DC YouTube channels, or wherever you get your podcasts.

description:
The Seattle Seahawks are focused on culture and mental toughness this week. Host Andrew Siciliano says this episode has it all: conflict, team building, sledgehammers, Fan Fest, Marshawn and a cliffhanger. Super Bowl Champion and NFL Analyst Michael Robinson joins Andrew to talk about why he loves Jadarian Price’s game and the mental and physical tenacity a team needs to even consider repeating a winning season.
